items.name: Download → extract → upload (cross-platform)
items.description: Open a Remote Play session (keeps the console awake), download a file, extract it locally, upload the result via FTP, then rest mode. Works for PS4 (GoldHEN FTP) or PS5 — adjust the destination path to your console.
items.author: P5 Manager

items.name: PS5: Full game pipeline (download → extract → mkpfs → FTP)
items.description: Open a Remote Play session (holds PS5 awake), download, extract, convert to .ffpfsc, upload via FTP, then rest mode. PS5-specific because of the mkpfs pack step.
items.author: P5 Manager

items.name: PS4: GoldHEN + FTP ready (wake → load → start FTP → verify :2121)
items.description: With an already-enabled BIN loader: wake the PS4, load goldhen.bin, then load ftp_server.bin and succeed when port 2121 (FTP) is open so you can immediately browse the PS4 from the File Ops tab.
items.author: P5 Manager

items.name: PS4: Load GoldHEN (wake → wait → send goldhen.bin)
items.description: Wake the PS4, wait 8 seconds for a manually enabled BIN loader, send goldhen.bin to TCP 9020, then verify the payload-sender port stayed open.
items.author: quatrixone

items.name: PS5: Guide loader → kstuff → ShadowMount → zftpd
items.description: When the PS5 is online and its ELF loader is closed: open the configured guide loader, wait for port 9021, send kstuff, ShadowMountPlus and zftpd, then verify FTP.
